LIFTING AND RIGGING SAFETY
Never stand or walk under a suspended load.
Inspect slings and shackles before every lift.
Know the load weight and the sling Working Load Limit.
Use a tag line to control the load.
Sling angle factor table:
| Sling Angle | Capacity Factor |
| 90 degrees | 1.00 |
| 60 degrees | 0.87 |
| 45 degrees | 0.71 |
| 30 degrees | 0.50 |
If in doubt about the lift plan, stop work and contact your supervisor.
